# Студия ComfyUI — ComfyUI photo & video textbook (Russian) for people and AI agents

> Measured recipes, theory and pitfalls for generating photos and videos with ComfyUI on a 16 GB consumer GPU
> (RTX 5070 Ti, 62 GB RAM, Windows 11) plus rented cloud GPUs: Krea 2, Qwen-Image 2.1, FLUX.3 Klein, MiniMax H3,
> LTX-2.5, editing and reference transfer, a fictional persona LoRA, anti-AI finishing, motion control (ControlNet, POV),
> talking persona (TTS locked into H3, lip-sync tests), long clips, a batch pipeline, HyperFrames editing,
> AI 3D game assets (Pixal3D / TRELLIS.2 image→mesh, game budgets, <model-viewer>). Human chapters are in
> Russian; the agent guide is English. Facts carry evidence tags: [MEASURED] (run by the authors), [SOURCE]
> (docs/community), [RULE] (derived decision). Version 2026-10-27a.

## Start here (agents)
- [agent-guide.md](agent-guide.md): English, dense — exact model files and settings, ComfyUI API driving, prompt templates, persona LoRA pipeline, evaluation metrics, RunPod procedure, editing rules, Windows pitfalls.
- [book.json](book.json): chapter index with section ids, status and English summaries.
- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): every human chapter as Markdown in one file (Russian).

## Chapters (Russian, Markdown)
- [01 Как устроен учебник](md/ch-intro.md): How the book is organised: audience, test bench (RTX 5070 Ti 16 GB / 62 GB RAM + RunPod RTX PRO 6000), evidence tags, experiment series, reading routes, ethics and licences.
- [02 Как работают генеративные модели](md/ch-theory.md): Theory for practitioners: diffusion / flow matching, latent space and VAE, text encoders (CLIP vs LLM), DiT and attention cost, steps / sampler / scheduler / shift, CFG and why distilled models use cfg 1, LoRA, quantisation and RAM offload, image-to-video and edit models.
- [03 ComfyUI: граф, ноды, workflow](md/ch-comfy.md): ComfyUI basics: nodes, typed links (MODEL, CLIP, VAE, LATENT, CONDITIONING, IMAGE), the minimal text-to-image graph, model folders, custom nodes, subgraphs and our one-node workflow style, workflows embedded in PNG/MP4, the HTTP API (/prompt, /history, /object_info, /free), caching and the queue.
- [04 Железо, файлы и облако](md/ch-studio.md): Hardware and cloud: local box limits, folder layout of ComfyUI Desktop, local vs RunPod vs hosted API cost/time table, platform comparison, safe rented-GPU routine, full-precision H3 on a 96 GB card vs the quantised local stack.
- [05 Кадр: фото на Krea 2](md/ch-stills.md): Photoreal stills on Krea 2 Turbo: simple one-pass vs the two-pass author recipe vs MOSS, fixing the 'AI face' (realism LoRA 0.5, upscale denoise 0.22, mature-feature words), strong body words at cfg 1.
- [06 Промпты](md/ch-prompts.md): Prompt lab (series 7, 156 stills on Krea 2 / Qwen-Image 2.1, 14 H3 clips): content and length beat style labels, tags = prose, 120+ words give full control, ≤ 2 actions per 5 s keep H3 faces stable; copy-paste templates for stills, H3 and references.
- [07 Правка кадра](md/ch-fix.md): Image editing toolkit, 150 edits on 9 stills: Qwen-Image 2.1 Turbo is the default editor (remove, background, outfit, sign text, hand, outpaint via new canvas), Krea 2 General Edit V2 for relight, BFS head swap as last resort, SeedVR2 7B sharp for 4K.
- [08 Финиш против ИИ-вида](md/ch-finish.md): Anti-AI finishing (series 4): generative passes (Krea img2img 0.12–0.3, FaceDetailer) wipe a persona's small marks and FaceDetailer makes faces look teen → none on persona shots; pixel finish wins blind A/B (stills 'subtle', selfies 'phone', video 'subtle_light'); ffmpeg deflicker hurts talking clips; H3 start pop fixed with a settle beat + core Video Slice 0.5 s.
- [09 Перенос по референсу](md/ch-ref.md): Reference transfer on 14 references: Qwen-Image 2.1 + one photo gives the best likeness (ArcFace 0.81, beats a 4000-step LoRA) but copies pose; FLUX.3 Klein for new poses/viewpoints; Krea style-reference LoRA is the only palette/light transfer; H3 Reference-to-Video with three canonical views keeps a persona's mole in place. Series 6b: the local FL2VA checkpoint also reads identity references via the stock MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo node (ArcFace 0.56 vs 0.26 text-only; RefMods add only packaging) → workflow 03R, 9.4 s in 759 s on a 16 GB RTX 5070 Ti (15.5 GB VRAM, 55 GB RAM). All four 10_ref_* workflows run locally in 10–27 s.
- [10 Видео на MiniMax H3](md/ch-video.md): MiniMax H3 image-to-video with audio: still → video → 48 fps pipeline, settings sweep (resolution beats steps, shift), length limits (≈ 12 s locally, frames 17k+5), chaining 5 s hops with guide frames, community finetune Eros Max vs official. Series 12: 10/15/20 s in one pass on a 96 GB cloud card (558/1072/1760 s, ≈ 10 GB VRAM) → the local 12 s cap is system RAM.
- [11 Скорость и качество](md/ch-speed.md): H3 speed vs quality: SageAttention (−41 %, same output), rejected 4-step turbo recipe (looks fine on calm 5 s, melts hands on hard 9 s), RAM budget, quality recipe = no turbo, 30 steps, res_multistep, shift 12; SeedVR2 and FILM for post.
- [12 Движение, POV и сцена](md/ch-motion.md): Motion control on H3 (series 9): Ref2VA keeps a persona's face far better than FL2VA on the same prompt/refs (ArcFace 0.72 vs 0.46); Fun ControlNet-Union 2.0 pose at 0.6 (1.0 copies moves but costs ~0.15 ArcFace), canny 0.8 restyles your own clip; arm's-length selfie and friend's-view POV work from text, mirror selfie needs an explicit reflection beat; 3×8 s mini-scene with hard cuts, one outfit lock, same refs and a frozen voice per shot.
- [13 Говорящий персонаж](md/ch-talk.md): Talking persona (series 11/11b): TTS track fed to H3 via ref_audios plus MiniMaxH3AddGuide audio at frame 0 comes out bit-exact (r 0.99–1.00) with lip sync ~2x H3's own voice; ref_audios alone re-voices and shifts 0.1–0.25 s; clean TTS sounds fake → band-limit, compress, echo, ambience; post-hoc LatentSync 1.6 copies the source mouth, MuseTalk 1.5 calms it but softens the face; the viewer kept plain H3 although the sync metric preferred a 0.22 s shift.
- [14 Сравнение моделей](md/ch-scout.md): Model scout on identical prompts: Krea 2, FLUX.3 Klein, Qwen-Image 2.1, Z-Image, MOSS, Anima, SDXL Juggernaut — strengths per task; render at native 2 MP; physics (hands using tools) only by eye; LTX-2.5 as the fast video draft path before H3.
- [15 Какие модели существуют](md/ch-models.md): Landscape of open image/video models (Oct 2026): MiniMax H3, LTX-2.5, Wan 2.2, Krea 2, FLUX.3 Klein, Qwen-Image 2.1, Z-Image — rankings, licences (H3 excludes the EU), why to test each.
- [16 Свой персонаж и LoRA](md/ch-persona.md): Fictional persona pipeline: hero face (age anchored by facial structure), turnaround with Qwen-Edit 2511, restaging into scenes, first-frame rules for H3, LoRA v1→v3 on RunPod (leak of marks to every woman, regularisation halves the steps in ai-toolkit, DOP + name-like trigger + 4000 steps fixes it: ArcFace 0.65, leak 0.15). Series 14: batch.py job files (Krea 2 Turbo + persona LoRA → score 0.7·ArcFace + 0.3·sharpness → top-k → H3 from kept stills), resume via results.json, disk guard, per-render GPU lock.
- [17 Датасеты для LoRA](md/ch-datasets.md): LoRA datasets: what 44 Civitai creators report (own generations, real photos, video frames, big curated sets, face-less crops), shared rules (diversity except the target, 1/3 close-medium-full, caption = future prompt, trigger first), our persona recipe, free datasets with licences, tools (img2dataset, JoyCaption, Qwen3-VL, Florence-2, imagededup, ArcFace).
- [18 Разбор креаторов](md/ch-creators.md): Creator breakdowns from Civitai generation metadata: Sleeps_In_Sunbeams — one-line prompts plus a stack of 3–6 style LoRAs on Krea 2 Turbo, 8–15 steps, cfg 1; file list with triggers; how to rebuild the stack.
- [19 Повтор трендов](md/ch-trends.md): Trend replication loop, one page per Civitai post: metadata via the public API, missing files, rebuilt graph, closest copy + two own-subject renders in the same aesthetic; what replicates on the first render and what needs the creator's LoRA.
- [20 Монтаж с ИИ](md/ch-editing.md): Editing with HyperFrames (HTML → MP4): 9:16 social cut on a music bar grid with ducking, seamless OBS loop + countdown, a data-driven explainer, ACE-Step music, loudness and grading measured; rules for an agent editor.
- [21 ИИ для 3D-ассетов](md/ch-3d.md): AI game assets on a 16 GB GPU: Krea 2 concept → Pixal3D (MIT, native ComfyUI) mesh with PBR in 99–190 s; native Decimate+UnwrapMesh+bake → 20k/5k/1.5k in one run; one style block → 8-prop set that reads as one game (give palette as accents only); Pixal3D meshes from 3/4-view concepts are tilted 15–37° about X → level them (ga_level.py); 32-direction sprite atlases and pixel art from Blender turntables (one shared palette, one px-per-metre scale); hex tiles: whole AI tiles fit a hexagon within 2–5 %, exact prism kit is flatter; Godot 4.7 bench (2500 props): triangles decide, not draw calls (auto-instancing); our 20k/5k/1.5k VisibilityRange chain 0.86 ms vs 9.79 ms plain 20k and 1.94 ms Godot auto-LOD; MultiMesh slower (no per-instance culling); browser demo (Three.js + 2D canvas): 3D meadow 30 draw calls / 120k tris, 61-tile hex board, pixel mode, WebAudio sounds.
- [22 Как мы оцениваем результат](md/ch-eval.md): Evaluation methods used in the book: Laplacian sharpness, ArcFace identity (thresholds 0.6 / 0.5 / 0.3), LAION aesthetic (matched a human ranking), CLIP (did not), OWLv2 + DINOv2 object match, centre PSNR, luma drift, corner diff, LUFS, WER, lip-sync correlation (rejected by a human), flicker; crop sheets, blind A/B, hard test scenes.
- [23 Workflow в ComfyUI](md/ch-workflows.md): Catalogue of the ready workflows (01 stills, 03 H3 video, 03c chain, 03R persona video from 3 reference views, 08 talking persona with a locked voice track, 04 post, 09_edit_*, 10_ref_*): what each does, knobs and toggles, measured time; folder convention for agent-built vs human workflows.
- [24 Грабли](md/ch-pitfalls.md): Pitfalls table: symptom → cause → fix (MOSS noise, sizes not multiple of 32, missing detector model, see-through fabric, two ComfyUI instances, background repaint after cropping, colour drift, finger melt, old-torch lip-sync repos on Blackwell, a cleanup script deleting a pod mid-render, ComfyUI cache returning stale batch outputs).
- [25 Словарь](md/ch-glossary.md): Glossary RU/EN: ~65 terms (attention, CFG, DiT, DOP, flow matching, LoRA, latent, quantisation, sampler, scheduler, shift, VAE…) with anchors and links to chapters.
- [26 Серии экспериментов](md/ch-lab.md): Research programme: about 20 experiment series (0–17 plus 6b, 9B, 11b, 13B), run by an AI agent with a fixed protocol; status of each, where it runs (local, RunPod, API).

## Optional
